description: Evaluation dataset for university policy question-answering benchmark.
instructions: Each test case specifies the query, expected answer, expected source document, page number, and question category.

questions.question: What is the minimum attendance percentage required for students?
questions.expected_answer: 75% attendance is mandatory for all courses

questions.question: What happens if a student's attendance falls below the required minimum?
questions.expected_answer: The student will be debarred from appearing in the end-semester examination

questions.question: How can a student apply for medical leave?
questions.expected_answer: Submit a medical certificate to the Dean of Students within 7 working days of returning

questions.question: What is the maximum number of days allowed for medical leave in a semester?
questions.expected_answer: 15 working days per semester with valid medical documentation

questions.question: What is the grading scale used by the university?
questions.expected_answer: 10-point CGPA scale where A+ is 10, A is 9, B+ is 8, B is 7, C+ is 6, C is 5, D is 4, F is 0

questions.question: What is the minimum CGPA required to avoid academic probation?
questions.expected_answer: A minimum CGPA of 5.0 is required to remain in good academic standing

questions.question: How many times can a student re-appear for a failed examination?
questions.expected_answer: A student can re-appear for a maximum of 3 attempts for any failed course

questions.question: What is the procedure for applying for re-evaluation of an answer sheet?
questions.expected_answer: Submit re-evaluation form within 10 days of result declaration along with prescribed fee to the examination cell

questions.question: Are students allowed to use calculators during examinations?
questions.expected_answer: Non-programmable calculators are permitted only for specified subjects as mentioned in the exam notice

questions.question: What are the penalties for using unfair means in exams as per Section 4.2?
questions.expected_answer: Cancellation of the exam, suspension for one semester, and a disciplinary entry in the student record

questions.question: What is the hostel curfew time for undergraduate students?
questions.expected_answer: 10:00 PM on weekdays and 11:00 PM on weekends

questions.question: What items are prohibited in the hostel rooms?
questions.expected_answer: Electrical appliances such as heaters, irons, and electric stoves; alcoholic beverages; and any inflammable materials

questions.question: How can a student apply for a hostel room change?
questions.expected_answer: Submit a room change request to the hostel warden with valid reason. Room changes are processed at the beginning of each semester only

questions.question: What is the hostel mess fee for a semester?
questions.expected_answer: Rs. 25,000 per semester for the regular mess plan

questions.question: What are the rules for overnight guests in the hostel?
questions.expected_answer: Guests are not permitted to stay overnight. Day visitors must register at the front desk and leave by 8 PM

questions.question: What CGPA is required to be eligible for the merit scholarship?
questions.expected_answer: A minimum CGPA of 8.5 in the previous academic year

questions.question: What is the amount of the need-based scholarship?
questions.expected_answer: Up to 100% tuition fee waiver based on family income assessment

questions.question: What documents are required to apply for the need-based scholarship?
questions.expected_answer: Income certificate, BPL card or income tax returns of parents, bank statements for the last 6 months, and a recommendation letter from the Head of Department

questions.question: Can a student hold multiple scholarships simultaneously?
questions.expected_answer: No, a student can hold only one university scholarship at a time. External scholarships may be held concurrently with approval from the scholarship committee

questions.question: What is the deadline for scholarship applications each year?
questions.expected_answer: August 31 for the academic year, with late applications accepted until September 15 with a late fee

questions.question: What is the anti-ragging policy and its penalties?
questions.expected_answer: Ragging in any form is strictly prohibited. Penalties include suspension, expulsion, FIR with police, and debarring from examinations as per UGC regulations

questions.question: How does the disciplinary committee handle complaints?
questions.expected_answer: Complaints are investigated within 7 days, a hearing is held within 14 days, and the decision is communicated within 21 days of filing

questions.question: What is the dress code policy for laboratory sessions?
questions.expected_answer: Students must wear lab coats, closed-toe shoes, and safety goggles during all laboratory sessions

questions.question: What is the process for forming a new student club?
questions.expected_answer: Submit a proposal with at least 20 student signatures, a faculty advisor, constitution, and budget plan to the Student Affairs office for approval

questions.question: If a student fails due to low attendance and also has a pending disciplinary case, which policy takes precedence for the exam debarment?
questions.expected_answer: Both policies apply independently. The attendance debarment is automatic per the attendance policy, while the disciplinary action follows the student conduct committee's decision

questions.question: What happens to a scholarship if the student's CGPA drops mid-year?
questions.expected_answer: The scholarship is placed on probation for one semester. If the CGPA is not restored by the end of the probation semester, the scholarship is revoked

questions.question: What is the library fine for overdue books?
questions.expected_answer: Rs. 5 per day for the first 7 days, Rs. 10 per day thereafter, with a maximum fine of Rs. 500

questions.question: How many books can a postgraduate student borrow at a time?
questions.expected_answer: Up to 6 books for a period of 30 days each

questions.question: What is the fee structure for international students?
questions.expected_answer: International students pay 2x the regular tuition fee plus a foreign student surcharge of USD 500 per semester

questions.question: What is the last date for fee payment without a late fee?
questions.expected_answer: Within 15 days of the start of the semester. A late fee of Rs. 100 per day is charged thereafter

questions.question: What is the refund policy if a student withdraws within the first month?
questions.expected_answer: 90% refund of tuition fee if withdrawn within 15 days, 75% within 30 days. Hostel and mess fees are non-refundable after the first week

questions.question: Does the university offer parking facilities for students?
questions.expected_answer: unanswerable

questions.question: What is the university's policy on cryptocurrency mining in hostel rooms?
questions.expected_answer: unanswerable

questions.question: Can students order food delivery to the hostel after curfew?
questions.expected_answer: unanswerable

questions.question: What is the procedure for semester withdrawal on medical grounds?
questions.expected_answer: Submit medical certificate from a registered medical practitioner, application to Dean of Academics, and approval from the medical board. Must apply within 30 days of the medical event

questions.question: How are internal assessment marks calculated?
questions.expected_answer: Internal assessment comprises 40% of total marks: 20% from mid-semester exam, 10% from assignments, and 10% from class participation and quizzes

questions.question: What are the eligibility criteria for the student council elections?
questions.expected_answer: Minimum CGPA of 7.0, no disciplinary record, enrolled as a full-time student, and completion of at least 2 semesters

questions.question: What is the policy on summer internship credits?
questions.expected_answer: Students can earn up to 4 credits for a summer internship of minimum 8 weeks duration, with a completion report and employer evaluation

questions.question: Compare the hostel fee refund policy with the tuition fee refund policy for a student withdrawing in week 2.
questions.expected_answer: Tuition fee gets 90% refund (within 15 days), but hostel fee is non-refundable after the first week. This means the student loses the full hostel fee but recovers most of the tuition

questions.question: What mental health resources does the university provide to students?
questions.expected_answer: unanswerable
